draftBefore.emotion: organized and forward-thinking, checking plans for the coming days
notes: This is a loanword from English, commonly used in everyday Hindi alongside the native word 'पंचांग' (panchang). While 'पंचांग' often refers to a traditional or astrological calendar, 'कैलेंडर' is used for the modern Gregorian system used in schools, work, and personal planning.

senses.definition: A chart or device showing the days, weeks, and months of a specific year.

examples.text: मैंने कैलेंडर पर अपनी छुट्टी की तारीख निशान लगा दी है।
examples.translation: I have marked the date of my vacation on the calendar.
examples.emotion: satisfied and relieved, having finally set the plan in stone

senses.definition: A printed collection of pages showing the days of the year, often hanging on a wall.
